name: scenarioId
label: Scenario ID
help: Map the Make scenario ID, for example {{scenario.id}}.

name: scenarioUrl
label: Scenario URL
help: Optional link back to the Make scenario or execution.

name: executionId
label: Execution ID
help: Map a Make execution ID when available.

name: executionUrl
label: Execution URL
help: Optional link back to the Make execution.

name: relatedItsmTaskId
label: Related ITSM Task ID
help: Optional related ITSM ticket, incident, request, or task identifier, for example INC0012345 or ITSM-123.

name: relatedItsmTaskUrl
label: Related ITSM Task URL
help: Optional direct link to the related ITSM task or ticket.

name: creditsConsumed
label: Credits Consumed
help: Optional. Map the number of Make credits consumed by this execution when available.

name: dataConsumed
label: Data Consumed
help: Optional. Map the amount of data consumed by this execution when available. Use bytes if Make exposes the value in bytes.

name: operationsConsumed
label: Operations Consumed
help: Optional. Map the number of operations consumed by this execution when available.

name: executionTime
label: Execution Time
help: Optional execution duration in HH:MM:SS format, for example 00:01:30. Execution Time Seconds is calculated automatically when the value has three colon-separated parts.

name: systemMessage
label: System Message
help: Map an error message or success summary, for example {{error.message}} in an error handler.

name: module
label: Module Name
help: Map the failing or reporting module name, for example {{error.module}} in an error handler.

name: customPropertiesToSend
label: Custom Properties to Send
help: Optional. Select Make scenario custom properties to include in the Observe payload. If nothing is selected, no custom properties are sent.

name: details
label: Details
help: Optional extra structured data to include in the Observe event.
